method: Actual STL head/catch section intersections over admitted XY/yaw poses
limits: Assumed dimensional losses, not printer measurements. Deepest local bearing chord is minimized over sampled poses; corner-tip overlap necessarily tends to zero. No force, friction, cam-out, out-of-plane flexure, layer adhesion, or durability prediction. The sampled yaw range is +/-0.75 degrees; this is not an exhaustive motion proof.
assumptions: Head/catch planar erosion plus inward spring set; extra mating radial play erodes actual neck/guide sections. All stated losses compound adversely.
